### Step 47 — exact alpha=1 canonical finite-grid correction
For the canonical rough tangent

```math
W(s)=sqrt(2)B(s)-|s|,
```


The continuous constant is `H_1^0=1`, while the discrete `alpha=1` Pickands constant is

```math
\boxed{
H_1^\delta
=\frac1\delta
\exp\left[-2\sum_{n>=1}\frac1n

=\nu(\sqrt{2\delta}).
}
```
